provider_treatment: One shared game: both recommender responses reach one buyer before one purchase decision.
recommender_information: Own full provider catalog, full user preference brief, exact buyer instructions, competing-provider identities and all game rules. No rival catalog or rival response, previous results, or feedback.
buyer_information: Private preferences, common rules, initial request, and both selected lists/messages together. No omitted records or evaluator-only forecasts.
recommender_objective: Each maximizes its OWN attributed realized purchase value, zero when none of its records are bought. Revenue proxy, not accounting profit.
buyer_objective: Maximize expected purchase satisfaction within $800, including seller trust and value for money.
recommender_actions: Any ordered subset of its frozen records plus accompanying text. Records cannot be modified.
buyer_actions: Any compatible subset of the union of returned lists, including cross-provider bundles, or decline; $800 applies to the total.
query_policy: Fixed initial query; no live recommendation engine calls.
candidate_policy: Each recommender ranks at least three distinct response candidates including empty list, with qualitative competition-aware own-revenue forecasts. Buyer ranks feasible union outcomes and decline. Unselected responses are not tested.
horizon: One independent response per recommender and one shared buyer decision; no response revisions or feedback.
prediction_status: Recommender forecasts are qualitative model judgments, not independently optimized expected-profit estimates.
payoff_attribution: Sum frozen prices of selected records originating in each provider catalog. Selecting an offer credits only its originating provider; no duplicate credit for alternative listings of the same product.
duplicate_policy: Preserve original record IDs and objects. Similar or duplicate offers are alternatives, not additional hardware or automatically identical products. Buyer must choose the actual purchased record(s). No fuzzy deduplication.
display_order_policy: Fixed provider blocks, configurable for counterbalancing; no result-based ordering. Record order inside each block chosen by its recommender.
equilibrium_status: One sampled action profile and buyer response, not an established Nash equilibrium or best response to an observed rival action.
